parent_objective: materialize artifact-only application-plan artifacts from M2381 design and M2378 patch artifacts
blocked_by: M2381 designs application-plan artifacts but does not materialize them
config patch application and candidate config generation remain blocked until application-plan artifacts are materialized and audited
supersedes: direct config patch application after application design
direct candidate config generation without application-plan artifacts

public_gates: M2382 must materialize application-plan artifacts from M2378 config-patch outputs and M2381 design
M2382 must preserve active-config overwrite, config-application, actor-input, oracle-feature, profile-tuning, collision, R4, diagnostic, and mixed guarded constraints
M2382 must not run reset rollout measured execution repair execution training replay PPO private holdout ranking or paper/self-ID/current-sim verdict claims
forbidden_shortcuts: do not inject hidden or oracle features
do not rank support policies or controller families
do not overwrite the active scenario config
do not write candidate config files
do not claim finite-window vs GRU conclusion
do not claim scenario redesign executed
do not claim training repair success

workflow_synthesis.evidence_increment: materializes artifact-only application-plan artifacts from overlay config patches without applying patches
workflow_synthesis.claim_scope: artifact-only application-plan materialization; no active config overwrite, config application, candidate config generation, repair execution, rerun, ranking, paper verdict, finite-window-vs-GRU, self-ID, scenario-redesign-executed, training-repair, or current-sim verdict claim
stop_condition: stop if active config overwrite occurs
stop if config patches are applied instead of referenced
stop if candidate config files are written
stop if any forbidden execution or claim flag is set
fallback_plan: route to result/failure audit for any artifact mismatch
route to application design repair if grouping schema is insufficient
route to M2383 result audit if gates pass

admission_evidence: M2381 defines application-plan schema and pass gates
allowed_updates: M2382 status queue scoreboard research log and review
one follow-up manifest for result audit
next_stage_criteria: patch reference counts match expected values
active config overwrite and patch application remain false

self_id_evidence_discipline.current_frame_substitution_risk: M2382 materializes application-plan artifacts and does not test history necessity.
history_necessity_tests: No wrong-history reset-hidden zero-history or finite-window-vs-GRU verdict is run in M2382.
self_id_evidence_discipline.temporal_evidence_window: M2378 config-patch artifacts, M2379 audit, M2380 synthesis, and M2381 application design.
self_id_evidence_discipline.negative_result_policy: Application-plan artifacts remain engineering design artifacts and cannot be interpreted as driver capability improvements.
allowed_claims: no controller ranking, paper-level result, finite-window-vs-GRU result, scenario-redesign-executed result, training-repair result, current-sim verdict, or level3 self-identification claim

local_search_guard.evidence_expansion: adds application-plan artifacts from config-patch route but does not yet test capability
local_search_guard.paper_verdict_delta: can admit application-plan result audit but cannot establish paper verdict
must_synthesize_if: M2382 produces application-plan artifacts but no result audit route
the repair-plan materialization branch reaches 10 milestones without synthesis

hypothesis: Artifact-only materialization can turn config-patch artifacts into application-plan artifacts without active config overwrite, config patch application, candidate config file generation, repair execution, ranking, or training-success claims.
success_criteria: active_config_overwritten is false and config_patch_applied is false
candidate_config_file_written_count actor_input_change_count hidden_oracle_feature_injection_count profile_specific_tuning_count ranking_admissible_count winner_selected_count are 0
environment_rollout_started policy_action_executed repair_execution_started training_started replay_started ppo_used are false
paper-level finite-window-vs-GRU level3 self-ID scenario-redesign-executed training-repair-success and current-sim verdict claims are false
failure_criteria: any required output family is missing
config patches are applied or candidate config files are written
patch artifacts include actor input changes hidden/oracle features profile-specific tuning ranking or winner selection
any forbidden execution or claim flag is set
decision_rule: M2382 passes if it materializes application-plan artifacts without active config overwrite, config patch application, candidate config file generation, repair execution, ranking, training, or paper/self-ID/current-sim verdict claims.
